answer: A new agent stakes a 200 POA identity bond in escrow, released only after its behavior fingerprint proves real work: steady cadence, varied counterparties, and an onyx-signed signal log for 20 epochs. An identity cannot fake that overnight, so its bond stays locked, decaying 5% per epoch until proven. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 POA plus faking 100 histories, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its bond in the oasis of shared work.
